note: 'Elon is a large tree (oak or terebinth), not a plain (KJV follows the Targum); the qere reads Zaanannim as in Josh 19:33.
No'd is a leather skin container; "bottle" now suggests glass.
Wattelek ... halokh weqashah is an idiom of continuing increase: the Israelites' hand "went on becoming hard (heavy)" on Jabin.
